summary: One-time onboarding surcharge line on finalized invoice after key-rotation triggered duplicate private postbacks
description:
Issue summary:
Customer (Veridian Health) received a finalized invoice (INV-2026-03-09-VER-001) that includes a one-time onboarding surcharge (~€3,250) which they had been verbally waived for during contract negotiation. The charge appears tied to 'onboarding-telemetry' line items generated by our ingestion pipeline from their private deployment.

Impact:
- Finalized invoice shows a one-time surcharge that the customer disputes; they are an enterprise customer with an executed waiver in our CRM.
- Customer is withholding auto-pay pending correction; potential churn risk.

Environment:
- Private deployment (on-prem telemetry adapter) in eu-west.
- Contract: Enterprise (waiver recorded in sales CRM: CRM-VER-2025-ONB-WAIVER).
- Date of invoiced run: 2026-03-09 (finalized).

Steps to reproduce / observed sequence:
1) Customer rotated API keys for their telemetry adapter during a scheduled maintenance window (2026-03-08 03:00-03:20 UTC).
2) Telemetry adapter performed a reconnect and retried several buffered metrics/postbacks to Redwood ingestion.
3) Postbacks arrived with mixed org tags: some records using old org_id and others with new org_id but same external request ids.
4) Postback-reconciler processed duplicates as distinct usage events because of the changed org tag and created 'onboarding-telemetry' line items for the new org mapping.
5) Finalized billing run attributed the one-time onboarding line to Veridian's invoice.

Logs / artifacts attached (IDs and excerpts):
- Customer-provided timeline and maintenance window email (VER-ops-2026-03-08.eml).
- Ingest logs: ingest-eu-west-2026-03-08-03-xx (sample lines included in comments).
- Invoice PDF: INV-2026-03-09-VER-001.pdf (customer attached).

Investigation notes so far:
- Billing team pulled postback trace for Veridian between 2026-03-08T02:50Z and 2026-03-08T04:00Z. Found ~1.2k postbacks flagged as 'onboarding-telemetry' origin, ~920 of which appear duplicated with similar payloads but different org tags.
- Reconciler behavior: duplicates are keyed by (external_request_id, org_id). Key rotation changed org_id mapping mid-replay causing the same external_request_id to be ingested twice.
- CRM waiver exists and was expected to suppress the onboarding surcharge at invoice finalization; waiver lookup uses canonical org id that matched the pre-rotation id only.
- Root cause hypothesis: telemetry adapter replays with mixed org identifiers after key-rotation, combined with reconciler dedup key that includes org_id and a waiver-lookup that queries pre-rotation canonical id.

Temporary workaround suggested:
- We can issue a provisional credit for the onboarding line and place a hold on auto-pay pending final reconciliation.
- Recommend a hotfix to reconciler: dedupe on external_request_id independent of org_id for a 30-minute replay window for private adapters that report key-rotation in metadata.

Next steps / ask:
- Confirm definitive list of duplicated postbacks and associated ingest IDs (billing needs a CSV export).
- Verify CRM waiver mapping supports both pre- and post-rotation org identifiers for the same customer.
- Coordinate with SRE and Private Deployments team to add metadata flag when adapters reconnect after key rotation.

Desired resolution:
- Remove the onboarding surcharge from the finalized invoice via credit memo and reissue corrected invoice OR apply a one-time credit and confirm with customer.
- Implement reconciler change or a compensating job to collapse historical duplicates for affected time window.
